//Logging: Every key under Logging:LogLevel is parsed as a log level, so never put a comment key
such as //Microsoft.AspNetCore there: it aborts service startup. Keep notes at this level.
//AllowedHosts: Host headers the service answers to, semicolon separated. Loopback only by default:
'*' switches host filtering off, which lets a page on any domain that resolves to
127.0.0.1 (DNS rebinding) reach the API under its own name. When ApiSettings.Host is
not loopback the service widens this list itself to include the bound address, or to
'*' for a wildcard bind that answers to every name the machine has.
//ApiSettings: Enabled       - set false to run the named-pipe surface only.
Host          - listen address. 127.0.0.1 keeps the API private to this machine;
use 0.0.0.0 to expose it on the LAN, which requires a Token.
Token         - null disables authentication, which is only allowed on a loopback Host.
A non-loopback Host without a Token is refused and the API is not started.
